Case: Officer signs in and lands on the Dashboard
Steps: Open the HIUSA address you were given. > Type 900004 in the box "School ID / ID Number". > Type the password in the box "Password". > Click "Sign in". > Read the page and the top bar.
Expected: You land on the officer Dashboard (the address ends in /dashboard/officer). The top bar shows your name and your organization with "SBO Officer". The side menu is the officer menu. No password change screen appears.

Case: A wrong password is refused with a clear message
Steps: Type 900004 in "Email or school ID". > Type a wrong password in "Password". > Click "Sign in". > Read the red message under the boxes. > Now type the correct password and click "Sign in" again.
Expected: The message reads: "The provided credentials are incorrect." You stay on the sign-in page and nothing about the account is revealed. The page shows the Forgot password? link beside the Sign in button for a reset. The correct password then signs you in.

Case: Signing in with empty boxes does not sign you in
Steps: Leave both boxes empty and click "Sign in". > Type only 900004 in "School ID / ID Number" and click "Sign in". > Clear it, type only a password and click "Sign in". > Read the message each time.
Expected: You are never signed in. A red message appears each time and you stay on the sign-in page. VERIFY: the wording. The page may say "Enter your school ID and password to continue." or repeat a field message from the server.

Case: The officer menu has exactly the pages an officer may use
Steps: Sign in as 900004 and look at the left menu from top to bottom. > Write down every group and page name you see. > Click each group name once and note which page opens first. > Click "Profile" at the bottom of the menu.
Expected: The menu shows: Dashboard. Ask AI. Events and tasks (Check-in, Calendar, Venue booking, My tasks), where Venue booking is listed only when the Admin has switched on "Can book venues" for the officer's position: on a fresh seed 900007 (Business Manager) sees it and 900004, 900005 and 900006 do not, so for them the group reads Check-in, Calendar, My tasks. Finance (view only) (Budgets, Ledger, Financial reports, Forecast). Members and fingerprints. Voting (Candidates, Voters, Results). Store (Orders, Claim desk). Updates (Announcements, Feed). Clearance signing. Records. My activity (Vote, Shop, My orders, My receipts, Statement of account). Small headings Manage, Community, Records and Me sit above the groups. A group opens its first page (Events and tasks opens Check-in, Finance (view only) opens Budgets, Voting opens Candidates, Store opens Orders, Updates opens Announcements, My activity opens Vote). Profile opens. There is no AI delegation, Approvals, People, Officer positions, Events, Planning, Tasks, Inventory, Collections and advances, Student accounts, Compliance, Grievances or Audit log.

Case: The four officer positions get the same menu, except Venue booking follows the position
Steps: Sign in as 900004 (Treasurer) and copy down the side menu. > Log out and sign in as 900005 (Auditor). Compare the menu. > Log out and sign in as 900006 (Public Information Officer). Compare the menu. > Log out and sign in as 900007 (Business Manager). Compare the menu. > On each account open Store > Orders and Updates > Announcements and look for buttons.
Expected: The menu and the pages are the same for all four, with one difference: Venue booking under Events and tasks is listed only for a position whose "Can book venues" switch is on (fresh seed: 900007 Business Manager yes; 900004 Treasurer, 900005 Auditor and 900006 Public Information Officer no). Every position can verify payments, release orders, check people in, update its own tasks and send announcements for approval. The position otherwise changes only the title shown under the name (see the Profile case) and which tasks the system suggests for the officer (see the AI delegation cases).

Case: Each officer position is shown on the Profile page
Steps: Sign in as 900004 and click "Profile" at the bottom of the menu. > Read the dark card on the left: name, role and the line under it. > Read School ID, Organization and Email address on the same card. > Log out and repeat for 900005, 900006 and 900007.
Expected: The role badge says "SBO Officer" for all four. The line under it is the position: 900004 Treasurer, 900005 Auditor, 900006 Public Information Officer, 900007 Business Manager. School ID and organization (PSITS-CCS) are correct.

Case: Typing the address of an Admin-only page sends the officer back to the Dashboard
Steps: Replace the page address with each of these and press Enter, one at a time: /dashboard/admin, /dashboard/approvals, /dashboard/admin/positions, /dashboard/admin/programs-sections, /dashboard/audit-logs. > Then try these: /dashboard/events/manage-events, /dashboard/events/event-planner, /dashboard/tasks/task-board, /dashboard/compliance, /dashboard/grievances. > Then try these: /dashboard/finance/collections, /dashboard/finance/student-accounts, /dashboard/merchandise/manage-inventory. > Then try these: /dashboard/elections/manage-elections, /dashboard/elections/manage-partylists, /dashboard/approval-requests/new/budget, /dashboard/approval-requests/new/event. > After each address, write down which page you ended on.
Expected: Every address sends you back to your own Dashboard (/dashboard/officer). No Admin page shows data or buttons, not even for a moment. There is no error page, you are simply returned to the Dashboard.

Case: Pages of the SAO, Department Head and Student are closed to the officer
Steps: Replace the page address with /dashboard/super-admin and press Enter. > Try /dashboard/super-admin/organizations and /dashboard/super-admin/academic-years. > Try /dashboard/department-head and /dashboard/department-head/approvals. > Try /dashboard/student, /dashboard/my-grievances and /dashboard/my-clearance. > Write down where you end up each time.
Expected: Each address returns you to the officer Dashboard. None of these pages opens for an officer.

Case: An officer cannot approve their own announcement
Steps: Look through the whole left menu for an Approvals item. > Open Updates > Announcements and click the title of your waiting announcement to open its panel. > Click the three dots (Announcement actions) on its row and read the choices. > Replace the page address with /dashboard/approvals and press Enter.
Expected: There is no Approvals item in the menu. The row shows the chip "Waiting for Admin approval". The panel says "Waiting for Admin approval. No action needed from you." The actions are only "View full record", "Edit announcement" and "Delete announcement". There is no "Approve & publish" or "Publish announcement". The Approvals address returns you to the Dashboard.

Case: Unknown addresses and signed-out visits
Steps: Replace the page address with /dashboard/not-a-page and press Enter. > Open the account menu (your name, top right) and choose "Logout", then confirm "Log Out". > Now type /dashboard/officer in the address bar and press Enter. > Sign in again. Then type /login in the address bar and press Enter.
Expected: The unknown address takes you to your Dashboard. After logout, the officer page address sends you to the sign-in page and shows no data. VERIFY: when already signed in, /login should send you to your Dashboard instead of showing the sign-in form.

Case: Open and use the side menu on a phone
Steps: Sign in on the phone. > Tap the "Open menu" button at the top left. > Tap "Events and tasks", then tap "Check-in". > Check that the menu closes and the Check-in page opens. > Scroll down the page and try to scroll sideways. > Tap "Open menu" again and tap "Close menu".
Expected: The menu slides open, the pages open from it, and "Close menu" hides it. The page fits the screen with no sideways scrolling. All buttons are big enough to tap without zooming.

Case: Go to page search shows only officer pages
Steps: Click "Go to page" in the top bar (or press Ctrl and K). > Type check and press Enter on "Check-in". > Open "Go to page" again and type inventory. > Clear it and type new ann. > Press Escape to close it.
Expected: "Check-in" is found and opens. For inventory the list says: No pages match "inventory". "New announcement" is found and opens the announcement form. Admin pages never appear in the list.

Case: Logging out asks to confirm and ends the session
Steps: Click your name (top right, "Account menu for ..."). > Click "Logout". > In the box "Log Out" click "Cancel" and check you are still signed in. > Open the account menu again, click "Logout", then click "Log Out". > Press the browser Back button.
Expected: The box says "You will need to sign in again to access your dashboard." Cancel keeps you signed in. Confirming returns you to the sign-in page. VERIFY: after Back, the dashboard must not show data and you are sent to sign in.

Case: Dashboard shows the work snapshot, urgent tasks and task chart
Steps: Click "Dashboard" in the menu. > Read the four cards under "Operations snapshot". > Read the table "Urgent Tasks" (Task, Assignee, Deadline, Status). > Read the bars under "Task Status Distribution". > Click "View all" at the top right of "Urgent Tasks".
Expected: The cards are "Open Tasks" (pending and in progress), "Upcoming Events", "Completed Tasks" and "Pending Orders". "Urgent Tasks" lists at most 4 open tasks, nearest deadline first. Each bar shows a count and a percent. "View all" opens My tasks. The "Open Tasks" number equals Pending plus In Progress on My tasks. Only tasks assigned to you are counted.

Case: Dashboard summary tiles go to the right pages (there is no Quick Actions box)
Steps: On the Dashboard read the tiles Open tasks, Upcoming events and Pending orders. > Click "Open tasks" and note the page. Go back to the Dashboard. > Click "Upcoming events", then go back. > Click "Pending orders".
Expected: Open tasks opens My tasks. Upcoming events opens the Calendar. Pending orders opens Orders. A tile shows only for a page the officer may use, and no tile leads to a closed page. There is no Quick Actions box on the officer Dashboard; shortcuts such as Check-in, My receipts and New announcement are reached from the left menu. An officer with no work yet sees "No work has been assigned to you yet" with an Open My tasks button.

Case: Items in Your work queue open the exact record
Steps: On the Dashboard find the box "Your work queue". > Click the first item in it. > Check the page you land on, then go back to the Dashboard. > Scroll to "What HIUSA noticed" if it is shown and click one insight link.
Expected: Each item opens a page the officer is allowed to use and shows the related record (for example the order in Store > Orders, or the task in My tasks). No link bounces you back to the Dashboard. VERIFY: the items depend on the data, so write down what you saw if the box is empty.

Case: Dashboard for an officer with nothing assigned
Steps: Open the Dashboard. > Read the section "Work queue". > Click "Open My tasks".
Expected: Instead of a wall of zeros the page says "No work has been assigned to you yet" with the help text "Tasks, orders to verify and events show up here once your Admin assigns them. Start by opening My tasks." and a button "Open My tasks". The Quick Actions box is still shown. VERIFY: the first-run view only shows when every count is zero.

Case: Check someone in by hand
Steps: Open Events and tasks > Check-in. > If you see an "Event queue", click the event (button "Open attendance for ..."). A single ongoing event opens by itself. > Write down the number under "Attendance records". > In the box "Manual check-in" type 2100142 into "Member". > Click the matching result (it shows the name and "2100142 · Student"). > Leave "Attendance status" on Present and click "Confirm check-in".
Expected: A green message says "Check-in recorded." The Member box is emptied. "Attendance records" goes up by 1. The student appears in the attendance log with status Present and method Manual. A mistyped ID is never recorded because you must pick the result and then confirm.

Case: Confirm check-in waits for a chosen member and saves Late and Excused
Steps: Look at the button "Confirm check-in" while the Member box is empty. > Type 2100217 but do not click the result. Look at the button again. > Click the result, set "Attendance status" to Late and click "Confirm check-in". > Check in 2200055 with the status Excused. > Read the tiles at the top ("Arrivals" and "Late") and the attendance log.
Expected: The button is greyed out until a result is clicked. Typing alone is not enough. Both check-ins save with "Check-in recorded." The log shows Late and Excused chips. The "Late" tile goes up by 1 for the Late record. The "Arrivals" tile counts only Present and Late members, so it never counts Absent. The choices in the list are Present, Late, Excused and Absent.

Case: Checking in the same member twice is refused
Steps: Type 2100142 in "Member" and click the result. > Click "Confirm check-in". > Read the red message. > Look at the number under "Attendance records" and the attendance log.
Expected: A red message such as "This member is already checked in for this event." appears. The count does not change and the student has one row only. VERIFY: the exact words of the message.

Case: Member search finds only members of your own organization
Steps: Type zzzz in "Member". > Clear the box and type 2400118. > Clear the box and type a few letters of a PSITS-CCS student name.
Expected: For zzzz and for 2400118 the page says "No matching members found." and the button stays greyed out. A PSITS-CCS student name shows matching results. Nobody from another organization can be checked in.

Case: Check-in lists only approved and ongoing events
Steps: Open Events and tasks > Check-in. > Read the line "N events open for check-in". > Compare the "Event queue" with the events in Events and tasks > Calendar and note their statuses. > In round 2 read the page when no event is listed. > If no event is ongoing, click the link "Go to Events" in the grey line.
Expected: Only events with status Approved or Ongoing are listed. Ongoing ones come first with a green dot. Planning, completed and cancelled events are missing. When none is ongoing the page says "No event is ongoing right now." with "Go to Events", which opens Calendar. When none is listed at all it says "No events ready for check-in" and "Approved and ongoing events will appear here."

Case: Search, filter and export the attendance log
Steps: Type part of one student name in "Search attendance". > Clear it and set "Filter attendance status" to Late. > Set it back to "All statuses" and click "Export CSV". > Type nonsense letters in "Search attendance". > Click "Refresh live data" at the top of the event.
Expected: The list narrows and the pill shows how many are "matching". A file named attendance-<event id>-<date>.csv downloads with columns such as School ID, Name, Status, Method, Check In and Recorded By. Nonsense shows "No attendance records match the filters." Refresh reloads the numbers.

Case: Fingerprint check-in card when the reader is missing, and when it is present
Steps: Find the card "Fingerprint check-in / checkout". > Read the coloured status line inside it. > Click the small refresh icon (Retry fingerprint reader). > Try to click "Scan Fingerprint". > Then use "Manual check-in" for a student to confirm it still works. > With a reader: click "Scan Fingerprint" and place one finger. > Read the window "Confirm fingerprint check-in" and click "Confirm check-in". > Try "No, Scan Again" on another scan.
Expected: Without a reader the line says "Reader unavailable" with "Connect the reader and make sure HID Authentication Device Client is running.", and "Scan Fingerprint" is greyed out. Manual check-in still works. With a reader the line says "DigitalPersona reader ready"; a match opens a window that names the student; confirming adds a record with method Biometric; "No, Scan Again" cancels without a record. VERIFY: the reader steps (no hardware seen when this case was written).

Case: Check someone in from a phone
Steps: Open Events and tasks > Check-in from the menu. > Tap the event under "Event queue". > Type 2200134 in "Member" and tap the result. > Tap "Confirm check-in". > Scroll to the attendance log and read the first card. > Tap "All Events" to go back to the list.
Expected: On a phone the list and the event are shown one at a time. After step 4 you see "Check-in recorded." The log shows a card with the name, a status chip, the check-in time and the method. "All Events" returns to the queue. Nothing runs off the screen.

Case: Browse events in list and calendar view with filters
Steps: Open Events and tasks > Calendar. > Read the four cards (Total Events, Upcoming, Completed, Total Tasks). > Type part of an event title in "Search events". > Change "Status" and "Sort by", then clear the filters. > Click "Calendar view" (button with the calendar icon), then "List view". > Click "View details" on one event.
Expected: The page title is Calendar. The list can be searched, filtered by date and status, and sorted. When nothing matches it says "No events match these filters" with a way to clear. The calendar view shows a month grid; clicking an event opens its details. There is no Academic period box: the list follows the semester the top bar shows.

Case: An officer cannot propose, edit or delete events
Steps: Open Events and tasks > Calendar. > Look for the buttons "New event", "Edit event", "Delete event" and "Cancel event". > Open "View details" of an event and look for edit controls. > Replace the page address with /dashboard/events/manage-events and press Enter.
Expected: None of those buttons exist for the officer and there is no Budget column. The event details are read only. The manage-events address returns you to the Dashboard. If the list is empty the page says "No events yet" and "Only your organization's Admin can propose events. Approved events appear here with their tasks and check-in."

Case: Request an on-campus venue
Steps: Open Events and tasks > Venue booking. > In "Find a venue" choose a "Venue" and a "From" and "To" date and read the availability list. > Click "Request a venue". > Choose "On campus", pick a "Venue", set "Start" and "End" on one day between 5:00 AM and 10:00 PM. > Optionally pick an event in "Link to an event". > Click "Send request".
Expected: A box "Booking request sent" shows "Venue request #n" with status Pending and the text "SAO will review this request. This is your booking reference, not an approval." After "Done" the request is listed under "My organization's requests" with status Pending. The SAO decides it later under Reviews > Venues.

Case: Venue request rejects missing or impossible times
Steps: Click "Send request" with every box empty. > Choose a venue, set "End" earlier than "Start" and click "Send request". > Set "Start" and "End" on two different days and click "Send request". > Set "Start" to 4:00 AM and "End" to 6:00 AM on the same day and click "Send request". > Set "Start" to 9:00 PM and "End" to 11:00 PM on the same day and click "Send request". > Switch "Venue type" to "Off campus", leave "Off-campus location" empty and click "Send request".
Expected: Messages appear in red and nothing is sent: "Choose an on-campus venue or enter an off-campus location and both times." then "The end time must be after the start time." then "Choose a time on one day between 5:00 AM and 10:00 PM." A time that clashes with an approved booking is refused by the system (VERIFY: its wording).

Case: Withdraw a pending venue request
Steps: Find the pending request under "My organization's requests". > Click "Withdraw". > In "Withdraw this booking request?" click "Cancel" first and check nothing changed. > Click "Withdraw" again and then "Withdraw request".
Expected: The message says "Booking request withdrawn." The status changes to Withdrawn and the Withdraw button disappears. The box said "SAO will be notified. You will need to submit a new request if you still need this venue."

Case: Start my task
Steps: Open Events and tasks > My tasks. > Write down the cards "Pending" and "In Progress" at the top. > Find the task and click "Start" in its Action column (on a phone: the card button "Start"). > Read the status and the progress line of the task.
Expected: The task status becomes "In progress" and the small stage bar moves forward. The "Start" button is replaced by "Complete". The top cards change: Pending goes down by 1 and In Progress goes up by 1. The progress is at least 1 percent.

Case: Complete my task after a confirmation
Steps: Open Events and tasks > My tasks. > Click "Complete" on the in-progress task. > In the window "Confirm Task Completion" click "Cancel" and check the task did not change. > Click "Complete" again, then "Confirm completion". > Read the task row and the top cards.
Expected: The window says: Mark "<task title>" as completed? Progress will be saved at 100% and the Admin will be notified. After confirming, the task shows Completed with 100 percent, "Completed" goes up by 1 and the buttons "Start" and "Complete" are gone. The Admin gets a notification (check this on 900001 if you can).

Case: Add a progress update and read the history
Steps: Open Events and tasks > My tasks and click "View task" in the row menu (on a phone "View details"). > In "Add Progress Update" set "Progress (%)" to 40. > Type a short text in "Update note", for example "Poster draft done". > Click "Save Progress Update". > Scroll to "Progress History".
Expected: The button "Save Progress Update" becomes available only after a note is typed. After saving, the progress shows 40% and "Progress History" has a new line with the status, 40%, the time, your note and "By <your name>". The same task row shows 40% complete.

Case: Progress update needs a note and a sensible percent
Steps: Leave "Update note" empty and look at "Save Progress Update". > Type a note with only spaces. > Type a real note and set "Progress (%)" to 150, then click "Save Progress Update". > Set "Progress (%)" to -5 and save again.
Expected: With an empty or spaces-only note the button is greyed out. The percent field stops at 99 in the arrows. A percent above 100 or below 0 is refused and the task keeps its old progress. VERIFY: the exact error text and whether the task list stays usable after the error.

Case: Task details window shows the stage, details and who set it
Steps: Open Events and tasks > My tasks and open "View task" on a task. > Read the title, the due date and the stage bar. > Read the box "Description", the box "Related Event" (if any) and the grey details (Assigned officer, Priority, Category, Required position, Progress, Academic period). > Close it with the X ("Close task details").
Expected: The window shows the stage steps, a short "what next" message, the details above and "Progress History". The assigned officer is you. For a completed task the "Add Progress Update" box is not offered. There is no "Reopen task" button.

Case: The officer sees only their own tasks and cannot manage tasks
Steps: Open Events and tasks > My tasks and read the task list. > Look for the buttons "New task", "Edit", "Delete" and "Reopen", and for the switch "Board / Progress". > Look at the filters row for an assignee filter. > Replace the page address with /dashboard/tasks/task-board and press Enter.
Expected: Only tasks assigned to you are listed, never another officer's. There is no "New task", "Edit", "Delete", "Reopen", no Board/Progress switch and no assignee filter. The task-board address returns you to the Dashboard. A completed task cannot be reopened by an officer.

Case: Search and filter tasks
Steps: Open Events and tasks > My tasks. > Type part of a title in "Search tasks, assignees, or events". > Set "Filter tasks by status" to In progress, then "Filter tasks by priority" to High. > Pick a date in "Filter tasks by deadline". > Click the clear option shown with the active filters. > Change "Academic period" to a closed one if the list has one.
Expected: The list and the count ("N tasks") follow each filter. Chips show the active filters. When nothing matches the page says "No tasks match these filters" and a clear button restores the list. A closed period shows the note "Completed semester tasks are available for viewing only." and the Start and Complete buttons are gone. Search only narrows the page on screen.

Case: My tasks when nothing is assigned
Steps: Open Events and tasks > My tasks. > Read the cards at the top of the page. > Read the middle of the page.
Expected: The page says "Nothing assigned to you yet" and "Your Admin delegates tasks here." The cards at the top show 0. There is no "Create your first task" button because only the Admin creates tasks.

Case: A task that waits for another task cannot be started
Steps: Open Events and tasks > My tasks and find the task marked Blocked. > Check whether a "Start" button is offered. > Open "View task" and read the message near the stage bar. > Finish the task it depends on (as the officer who owns it), then return to this task.
Expected: The blocked task shows "Blocked" and "Blocked by <title>" and has no Start button. The detail window says the task must wait ("Finish that task first."). Once the other task is completed the Start button appears.

Case: Update a task from a phone
Steps: Open Events and tasks > My tasks. > Read the task card (title, status, progress bar, deadline). > Tap "Start" on the card. > Tap "View details" and add a progress note. > Tap "Complete" on the card and confirm.
Expected: Tasks show as cards, not a wide table. The buttons "View details", "Start" and "Complete" are easy to tap. The status moves Pending, In progress, Completed. No sideways scrolling.

Case: AI delegation is not an officer page (not part of the system for officers)
Steps: Look in the left menu under Events and tasks for AI delegation. > Type /dashboard/tasks/ai-delegation in the address bar and press Enter.
Expected: Not part of the system for officers: AI delegation is not in the officer menu, and the address sends the officer back to the Dashboard. Only the Admin opens AI delegation, because the Admin is the person who assigns tasks. An officer sees only the tasks assigned to them under My tasks. The position-based recommendation is checked as the Admin in SBO-042.

Case: The officer position decides who the system recommends for a task
Steps: As Admin 900001 open Events and tasks > Tasks and click "New task". > Type the title "Prepare budget report" and choose the Finance category, then click "Review officer recommendation". Write down who is "Recommended". > Repeat with the title "Design poster and promote on social media" and the Publicity category. > Repeat with the title "Set up venue equipment" and the Logistics category. > Create the logistics task for the recommended officer and sign in as that officer. > Open Events and tasks > My tasks.
Expected: Finance work is recommended first to the Treasurer (900004) or Auditor (900005). Publicity work goes to the Public Information Officer (900006). Logistics work goes to the Business Manager (900007). The best officer is tagged "Recommended" and the position fit is shown as a primary or related match. The created task appears in that officer's My tasks. VERIFY: scores depend on workload and history, so a different officer may rank first on a copy with many tasks.

Case: Budgets are readable but cannot be changed
Steps: Open Finance (view only) > Budgets. > Read the grey note at the top. > Look for the buttons "Propose budget", "Edit" and "Delete". > Open "View details" on a budget if one is listed.
Expected: The note says "View only. You can review and export these records; the organization admin records and changes them." A box shows "Ledger net balance" for the semester the top bar shows. There are no buttons to propose, edit or delete. If nothing is listed the page says "No budgets to show yet" and "Only the organization Admin proposes budgets. They appear here, with their approval stage, once the Admin proposes one."

Case: Ledger is read only with search and filters
Steps: Open Finance (view only) > Ledger. > Read the cards Income, Expenses, Net balance and Ledger entries. > Type a word in "Search transactions..." and press Enter. > Set "Filter by transaction type" to Expense and click "Apply". > Set "Filter from date" and "Filter to date" and click "Apply". > Look for "Record transaction", "Edit transaction" and "Delete transaction".
Expected: Totals and the list follow the filters and cover only the semester the top bar shows. When nothing matches the page says "No matching transactions" with a clear option. There is no way to record, edit or delete a transaction. With an empty ledger the page says "No transactions to show yet". VERIFY: the view-only note mentions export, check whether this page offers an export button.

Case: Financial reports can be viewed, exported and printed but not prepared
Steps: Open Finance (view only) > Financial reports. > Look for the panel "Prepare a report". > Type a word in "Search reports" and use "Filter reports by status". > Click "View details" on a report. > Click "Export Excel", then "Download PDF", then "Preview / print".
Expected: There is no "Prepare a report" panel. Each saved report shows its type, a status such as draft or pending, and a stage bar. The three buttons produce a file or a print preview. With no reports the page says "No saved reports to show yet" and "Only the organization Admin prepares financial reports."

Case: Forecast is read only
Steps: Open Finance (view only) > Forecast. > Read the top of the page and the note. > Look for the button "Generate forecast".
Expected: The note "View only..." is shown. There is no "Generate forecast" button. With no data the page says "No forecasts to show yet" and "Only the organization Admin generates forecasts. They appear here once one is generated." If a forecast exists a chart is shown.

Case: My receipts and Statement of account show the officer's own records
Steps: Open My activity > My receipts. > If a receipt card is shown click "View Receipt", then "Print receipt". > Open My activity > Statement of account. > Read the heading and the table.
Expected: My receipts is titled "Personal Receipts". With none it says "No receipts yet" and "A receipt appears here after a payment you made is verified by the organization." The Statement of account page is titled "Statement of Account & Financial Clearance" and says "No invoices have been issued to you." when there are none. Only your own records show, never those of other members.

Case: The member directory lists students only and can be searched
Steps: Click "Members and fingerprints" in the menu. > Read the two cards at the top ("Students" and "Fingerprint directory"). > Open the filter "All roles" and read its choices. > Type a student name in the search box "Search name, school ID, program, or email". > Use "Filter by program", "Filter by year level" and "Filter by section", then "Sort users". > Clear the filters.
Expected: The page is titled "Members and fingerprints". The card "Fingerprint directory" says "Attendance use only". The role filter offers only "All roles" and "Student". Admins, officers and the Department Head are never listed. Search and filters narrow the table and the count; a column shows who has "Fingerprint enrolled". When nothing matches the page says "No users found."

Case: The officer cannot create, edit, import or delete accounts
Steps: Open Members and fingerprints from the menu. > Look at the top right of the first box for buttons "New User", "Import", "Export" and "Add existing user". > Open the row menu (three dots or the action icons) of one student. > Write down every action offered.
Expected: None of "New User", "Import", "Export" or "Add existing user" is shown. The row actions are only "View profile", "Enroll fingerprint" (or "Re-enroll fingerprint") and "Verify identity (1:N)". There is no Edit user, Deactivate account or Delete profile. Account administration stays with the Admin.

Case: View a student profile
Steps: Open Members and fingerprints. > Choose "View profile" for student 2100142. > Read the window "User Profile". > Close the window.

Steps: Open Members and fingerprints and choose "Enroll fingerprint" for student 2100142. > Read the window "Enroll Fingerprint" and the status line. > Look at the main button and the box "Capture progress". > Tick the box "I confirm the user consented to biometric enrollment..." and look at the button again. > Close the window, then choose "Verify identity (1:N)" on the same row and read it.

Steps: Open Voting > Candidates. > Read the election card (status, Positions, Candidates, Votes, the line starting "Next:"). > Type part of the title in the search box, then use "Filter elections by status". > Click "Open election". > Read "N candidates registered for <election>" and click a position button to filter.

Steps: Open Voting > Candidates and open the election. > Click "Add Candidate". > Type a student name in "Student *" and choose the student. > Choose a position in "Position *" and keep "Party List" on Independent. > Type a short text in "Platform Statement". > Click "Add Candidate" in the window.

Steps: Open Voting > Voters and open the election if asked. > Read the line above the table. > Type a student name in "Search voters" (Name or school ID). > Open the list "Vote" and choose "Voted", then "Not yet voted", then "All voters". > Select Clear. > If there is more than one page use the page buttons at the bottom.

Steps: Open Voting > Candidates and look for "Create your first election", "Edit", "Delete", "Open voting" and "Close". > Replace the page address with /dashboard/elections/manage-elections and press Enter. > Try /dashboard/elections/manage-partylists and /dashboard/approval-requests/new/election. > In round 2 read the page when no election is shown.

If an order ever has no proof attached (for example one that was not made on screen) the window says "No payment proof is attached." and "Verify and submit" is greyed out. The Admin sees "Approve payment" instead.

Case: The claim token only exists after the Admin approves the payment
Steps: Open Store > Orders and read the verified order. Note there is no token. > Open Store > Claim desk and set the register to "Pending claim". After approval, without a reload, the list shows the order as Paid with "Step 3 of 4: Paid", the line "Release at the claim desk" and the button "Release order". Steps: Open Store > Claim desk and read "Claim desk register". > Set "Filter claim tokens by status" to "All claim tokens", then "Pending claim", then "Claimed". > Open the row menu "Actions for Order n" and select "Review order". > If a list is empty read the message and click "Open orders" if it is offered.

Steps: Open Updates > Announcements and read the four numbers (Matching records, Published, Waiting for approval, Recorded views). > Type a word in "Search title, content, or author". > Change the Category, Audience and publication state filters and the Sort choice. > Set "Created from" and "Created to". > Click "Export CSV". > Clear the filters.

Steps: Click the three dots on your published announcement and choose "Edit announcement". > Change the title and click "Save Record". > Read the chip on the row and look for it in Updates > Feed. > Click the three dots again and choose "Delete announcement". > In the box "Delete announcement" click "Delete".

Steps: Open Profile and find "Password & security". > Click "Update password" with every box empty. > Fill "Current password" with a wrong password, a valid "New password" twice, and click "Update password". > Use a new password shorter than 8 characters, then two different passwords in "New password" and "Confirm new password". > Click the eye icon next to a box ("Show new password"). > Do a correct change and then change it back.
